Vicky Clarke took on the last leg last year and just narrowly missed out on bringing the Belles home with a gold medal. Starting off in 8th spot it was too much of an ask for her to get anywhere near the medal positions this time round, but Vicky is another gutsy runner who likes to chase and set of…
